operationKinds.constraints: Не принимает raw BotSpec или runtime identity.
operationKinds.description: Начинает логическое описание бота поверх system seed.
operationKinds.input: Имя, locale, необязательное описание и logical entry block.
operationKinds.result: Нейтральный seed BotSpec заменяется новым generated scaffold.

operationKinds.constraints: Scope/type существующего поля не меняются через upsert.
operationKinds.input: Logical key, label, scope, value type и bounded constraints.

operationKinds.constraints: Нет provider payload, binary asset или dynamic template code.
operationKinds.input: Logical key, format, text и required/optional DataField keys.

operationKinds.constraints: Не принимает raw actions, input, call или handlers.
operationKinds.input: Logical key, stateful/transient mode, text и continuation для transient.

operationKinds.constraints: Content reference проверяет canonical preview.
operationKinds.input: Logical block key и content key.

operationKinds.constraints: Нельзя передать button AST или callback/runtime IDs.
operationKinds.input: Block/content keys и bounded choices с logical save/target keys.
operationKinds.result: Canonical choice actions и необходимые structural bridges.

operationKinds.constraints: Только bounded static routes.
operationKinds.description: Задаёт entry, command или fallback route.
operationKinds.input: Route kind, target block и command для command route.

operationKinds.constraints: Нет generated deep-link или provider payload.
operationKinds.input: Payload token и target block key.

operationKinds.constraints: Regex и expression input отсутствуют.
operationKinds.description: Задаёт exact text route на logical block.
operationKinds.input: Block, bounded equalsAny, target и optional ignoreCase.

operationKinds.constraints: Retry/timeout и raw input AST не принимаются.
operationKinds.description: Добавляет typed input в root block.
operationKinds.input: Block/field/next keys и input type.
operationKinds.result: Canonical typed input с generated structural flags.

operationKinds.constraints: Blocks добавляются отдельными semantic operations.
operationKinds.input: Logical key, field inputs/outputs, entry и result blocks.

operationKinds.constraints: Return bridge создаётся adapter, raw marker не принимается.
operationKinds.input: Subflow/block/field/next keys, prompt, type и optional contact label.
operationKinds.result: Canonical scoped input и request_contact action при необходимости.

operationKinds.constraints: Не содержит действий или runtime continuation.
operationKinds.input: Subflow key и block key.

operationKinds.constraints: Call+actions невыразим через эту operation.
operationKinds.input: Call block, Subflow и continuation keys.

operationKinds.constraints: Нет действий, expressions или dynamic code.
operationKinds.input: Result field, bounded scalar rules и otherwise result.

operationKinds.constraints: Global types/references проверяет preview.
operationKinds.input: Subflow/block/RuleSet/next keys.

operationKinds.constraints: Только code-owned registry; без вложенных transforms.
operationKinds.input: Subflow/block/target, registry operation, literal/field args и next.

operationKinds.constraints: Нет secret value, arbitrary header или Markdown URL.
operationKinds.input: Logical key, raw HTTPS endpoint, method, logical credential ref, mappings.

operationKinds.constraints: trusted_only operations fail closed до Patch.
operationKinds.input: Block, code-owned operation key и bounded scalar input.

operationKinds.constraints: Нет raw acceptance AST, restart или lifecycle mutation.
operationKinds.input: Scenario key/description и start/choose/text/contact/command/finish steps.
operationKinds.result: Canonical BotAcceptanceSpecV1 с generated proof steps.

operationKinds.constraints: Scenario references проверяет canonical qualification gate.
operationKinds.input: Qualification key и scenario keys.
